versions.name: Small-Boat Sailing
versions.description: Rig a small sailboat and take it through the basic points of sail, tack and jibe around a course, get out of irons, recover from a capsize, and tie the knots that hold everything fast.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
